newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway issues new T-bill for 12.5 billion crowns.
newsitem.headline: Norway issues new T-bill for 12.5 billion crowns.

text.p: Norway's central bank said on Thursday the Finance Ministry had issued a new treasury bill known as SS46 for 12.5 billion crowns with 500 million crowns reserved for the bank.
The T-bill will be issued by ordinary auction with final date for tenders at 0900 GMT on January 20.
The bank said the T-bill had a nominal interest rate of 3.50 percent and that it would mature on May 20.
